comment: EXPERIMENTAL Track B (LWS) Databox component wiring (ADR-0024, DBX-09 scaffold).
CIV-C26 update: the seam layer IS now Components.js-registered — the classes emit components
(strict `componentsjs-generator` clean), so entries below are real wiring where the seam's
constructor params are config-loadable. Seams whose params are function-typed or need a
config-loadable source (the crosswalk document, the input-resolver's per-request collaborators)
are still composed programmatically — named honestly in their comments.
Where a DBX prompt delivered a real implementation, the seam names it; the DBX-09 fail-closed
placeholders remain in source and are exercised by FailClosedStubs. Nothing here is spliced
into the core PermissionReader union or ResourceStore middleware chain: DBX-14 splices the
composed authorizer, DBX-17 splices the append-only store. Loading this preset does not change

@graph.comment: C3 authenticated-context extractor seam: VerifiedAssuranceContextExtractor (DBX-12) over a SignedAssuranceCrosswalk carrying the per-program signed crosswalk document. CIV-C26: now real wiring — the crosswalk document is bound from a variable (the deployment's signed per-program document, verified + version-checked on admission).

The per-program signed assurance crosswalk (ADR-0010) — the claim→assurance escalation surface, admitted only through signature + version checks. A real deployment inlines its OWN signed, verified crosswalk document; the document here is the experimental reference shape.

comment: C5 tenant resolver seam: RegistryTenantResolver (DBX-11) over a RelationshipMappingRegistry and
TenantBindingRegistry plus the box-root base. CIV-C26: these seams now EMIT Components.js
components, so this is REAL wiring — the in-memory registries are process-local reference
stores (ADR-0016/HD-10); a production deployment substitutes durable, access-audited stores

@graph.comment: The relationship-mapping registry backing the tenant resolver — process-local reference store (ADR-0016; a durable store substitutes behind the interface).
The tenant-binding registry backing the tenant resolver — process-local reference store (DBX-11).

C4 composed Databox authorizer (DBX-14) — REAL wiring. ComposedDataboxPermissionReader over the production input resolver (CIV-C25) + the collaborators (CIV-C26). It composes the Track-A WAC source with the Databox conjuncts — a Databox rule can only NARROW, never broaden (two-plane).
The production authorization-input resolver (CIV-C25) — assembles the per-request conjuncts from their authoritative sources; every collaborator is a wired concrete impl (CIV-C26).
Path→class convention classifier — the deployment's record/submission classes are bound here (reference impl; a deployment substitutes its catalog).
Per-request relationship + credential-status re-check (DBX-13) over the relationship registry + the credential status list.
The credential status list (ADR-0007) backing the revocation re-check — the herd-privacy bitstring the verifier reads.
The append-only accepted-resource index (C6 / ADR-0018) — reads the governed store's existence so a replace/delete on an accepted resource is denied for EVERY actor.
The per-op ODRL precondition (C12 / ADR-0013) — PolicyEvaluator over the immutable PolicyRegistry, with the trusted decision clock.
The deterministic ODRL policy evaluator (DBX-20) over the immutable policy registry.
The immutable policy registry the evaluator resolves governing versions from.
The delegation-grant validity check (C9) over the grant registry + trusted clock.
The delegation-grant registry (reference in-memory; a durable grant store substitutes).
C10 opaque box-identifier generator seam: RandomOpaqueIdentifierGenerator (DBX-10), 128-bit CSPRNG identifiers under the deployment base URL.

C13 evidence ledger seam: HashChainedEvidenceLedger, the real DBX-19 ledger. The contract evolved past the DBX-09 seam shape: it appends LedgerAppendInput/LedgerEntry (databox/evidence/EvidenceLedgerStore), superseding EvidenceEvent. Process-local until a durable store backs it (CIV-C10).

C15 cursor / committed-event feed seam: RetentionBoundedCursorFeed (DBX-21), retention-bounded in-memory feed; AuthorizedCursorFeed wraps it with the connection's tenant binding. A production deployment wires the durable outbox-backed feed.
